title: SCHC spec and rule-version vectors describe contradictory Rule7/helper semantics
description: spec/03-adaptation.md states canonical rules including Rule7 are implemented in python/schc/rules.py, but specialized Rule7 exists only in headers.py and is absent from RULES. Rule-version vectors call operational Rule7/64-66 absent while rejection text calls 64-66 defined wire building blocks and labels truncated Rule66 rather than unknown. Reconcile exact implementation/spec/oracle semantics and descriptions so cross-implementation consumers test one unambiguous contract.
notes: Clarified spec/03-adaptation.md: generic descriptor registry Rules 0-6/255, canonical specialized wire Rule7 in Python headers.py/Rust codec.rs, and Python helper descriptors 64-66 are non-wire. Reconciled rule_versioning.json descriptions and changed stale Rule66 truncated expectation to unknown_rule_id; added explicit specialized/helper metadata. Relevant vector/SCHC/RPL tests, Ruff, mypy, diff-check pass. Leave open for independent convergence.
